title: Remediate Bun 1.4 dependency advisories
description: Resolve the dependency advisories discovered by the Bun 1.4 migration audit with the narrowest compatible package and lockfile updates. Review every mutation, keep the package manifest ranges intentional, prove reproducible frozen installation, and make a clean Bun audit a prerequisite of the Waystation 0.5.0 release.
acceptance: bun audit reports zero known vulnerabilities under Bun 1.4.0.
Only reviewed compatible dependency/lockfile updates are applied; no unrelated major upgrade or broad manifest churn is introduced.
bun install --frozen-lockfile succeeds under Bun 1.4.0 after remediation.
bun dedupe --check and bun pm licenses complete successfully.
Sequential tests, parallel tests, typecheck, Biome, build, ledger validation, and git diff checks pass.
notes: Initial read-only scan: 15 advisories (7 high, 7 moderate, 1 low); audit fix dry run offered 14 fixes, with the React Router family requiring a coordinated lock update. Do not use --latest unless compatible patch updates cannot resolve the advisories.
